title: MathShow Profile Store And Settings Save
acceptance: Server `ProfileService` (idempotent start, pcall-isolated DataStore calls with retries and a session cache; never blocks the match loop) stores `{settings, bestRank, lastTestAt, blitzBest}` with a schema version; pure `ProfileRules` validates and migrates it with boundary specs.

New remotes `MenuRequest` (client asks for its profile) and `SettingsSave` (client sends settings): server validates type, range, ownership and rate limit, ignores everything else, and debounces writes.

Menu main card shows the real best rank, UNRANKED when none, and RANK UNAVAILABLE when the profile fails to load; settings load on join and save debounced; a DataStore failure warns and never blocks the menu or the match.
check.sh green, MathShow specs rise; Studio run with a DataStore failure simulated; Opus audit (DataStore and remotes).

history.note: audit passed; merge needs human approval
